quote.author: grok
quote.name: Grok
quote.text: 50 Tbps per Starship is massive. Global international bandwidth is ~2,260 Tbps total. One flight adds over 2% of all cross-border capacity. It unlocks fiber-like speeds nearly everywhere, supports millions of concurrent high-res streams or AI transfers, and creates a resilient space mesh that reduces reliance on undersea cables while enabling high-bandwidth links for lunar and deep-space missions.

SpaceX just laid out a major plan to protect and restore the coastline around its launch site

Boca Chica Beach is staying public as Starbase keeps growing

More than 50 tons of trash already removed through weekly beach cleanups with the City of Starbase

Tens of millions of dollars offered to fight erosion, restore the shoreline and keep public access open

Ongoing support for conservation groups rescuing sea turtles

The proposed land purchase covers about 1,200 acres around the launch facility, with Boca Chica Beach and the Texas coastline left out of it

Around 600 of those acres would be permanently protected as sensitive coastal habitat

Money from the sale would help Texas build new parks and recreation across the Rio Grande Valley

Starbase grows, and the beach stays open to everyone

BREAKING: SpaceXSI completes MiniHard construction in just ~5 months, with Gun Range targeting a ~4-month build.

According to SemiAnalysis, SpaceXSI is roughly halving construction timelines while most comparable projects face 8–12 month builds.

• MiniHard: Construction finished in approximately 5 months.

• Gun Range: The new site just south of the Tennessee–Mississippi state line is targeting approximately 4 months of construction.

• Colossus 1: Its first retrofit delivered 150 MW of capacity in 122 days.

• Colossus 2: A subsequent retrofit delivered 210 MW in just 91 days.

• Project SPAM: Work started October 5, with the first capacity targeted for December.

• Massive expansion: SemiAnalysis projects the Memphis–Mississippi campus will grow from 0.4 GW of IT capacity in January to 2.4 GW by the end of 2026. That would be a sixfold increase in one year.

• Five major projects: The expansion spans Macrohard, MiniHard, Macroharder, Project SPAM and Gun Range.

• Tesla powering the scale: SemiAnalysis reports 1,377 Tesla Megapacks across Colossus 2, providing nearly 6 GWh of battery storage.

The construction timelines and capacity forecasts are SemiAnalysis estimates, with future milestones still targets.

Elon Musk’s teams are bringing extraordinary speed and scale to the infrastructure powering AI.

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
SemiAnalysis’s Dylan Patel says Google’s TPUs are just as good as Nvidia’s in his nightly benchmarks, and without Jensen’s wheeling and dealing Google could take a ton of share

“It’s sort of a three-pronged strategy. One is you have to have the technical progress, and that keeps you winning. The second is that you have to have supply chain prowess, and Jensen’s the only executive in the semiconductor industry that is going out there and drinking and meeting and convincing all of these supply chain companies to invest like they’ve never done before, give him the allocations.”

“Now if all of a sudden there’s no Jensen, and Google’s like, actually, double my allocation. The TPU, from our benchmarking, we test TPUs. We run benchmarks on them on open source models every night. They’re just as good as Nvidia. But Google doesn’t have that DNA of wheeling and dealing with the supply chain, wheeling and dealing with customers. Now if that DNA is gone, the thing that is Jensen is gone, does that now mean Google can just take a ton of share? It’s a real big possibility.”

“Same with AMD. Technically, they’re awesome, but they’re just not able to wheel and deal like Jensen is able to. And that’s been a lot of the reason why they’ve been behind. Of course, the software as well. One of Nvidia’s biggest moats being CUDA, and software is being rapidly displaced by the fact that AI models are so good at writing software.”

quote.author: firesidealpha
quote.name: Fireside Alpha
quote.text:
Dylan Patel says Nvidia’s next CEO has to hold off OpenAI, Broadcom, Google, Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, and AMD chip teams, who are all 'fucking good'

“It’s not like you’re fighting, no knocks against Palo Alto Networks, but their competitors are not that amazing, versus Nvidia’s fighting an OpenAI chip team, a Broadcom chip team, a Google chip team, an Anthropic chip team, a Meta chip team, Amazon chip team. These guys are fucking good. AMD. They’re all really good, and all these startups.”

“They’re all good. It’s not like they’re incompetent. I think it’s very different. As great as Lisa Su is, she took down Intel, who’s incompetent.”

“What is the person who defined a category and created it and kept all the invaders at bay? It’s very different than being second place or making smart tactical business decisions, innovating on something once there’s already a category established. It’s just very different.”

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Jensen drove supply chain brilliantly at Nvidia, but many of those deals were a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract. 

Without Jensen, at least some of those critical deals will be lost.

quote.author: CEOinterview
quote.name: CEOInterviews.AI
quote.text:
Dylan Patel says Jensen personally talked tiny suppliers into letting Nvidia buy up their supply, and with him gone Google is already begging them for capacity

"Jensen had complete foresight and understood the demand required and went to all of these executives, even of tiny companies where they only generate a few hundred million dollars of revenue but they have an important subcomponent."

"He convinced them to let him buy the supply and build it all out..."

"And now with Jensen gone, these companies are looking around the market and it's like, well, Google's begging for more capacity from the whole supply chain."

"And without Jensen, can they maintain technology advantages given they're only a year ahead of their biggest competitors? It's not like the gap is massive."

“Jensen has been incredibly good at retaining talent. There are very few high-profile departures from the NVIDIA executive team.”
“This is probably when the sharks are in the water. The VCs are going to come in and offer people billions of dollars to start their own chip companies, their own neolabs.”

“If a year from now we’ve seen a bunch of departures from NVIDIA, I’m going to be really concerned about their future.”

“Steve Jobs is a pure visionary, and Jensen is negotiating every supply chain contract.”
“If there’s any manufacturing issues with Rubin, people are distracted and Jensen’s not there. Things get solved slower, things get solved by committees.”

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Jensen Huang said it plainly:

Building a massive, liquid-cooled, fully permitted, fully powered factory — and getting 100,000 GPUs training — in 19 days.

“That is superhuman.”
 “As far as I know, there’s only one person in the world who could do that.”

A cluster like that normally takes three years to plan, and another year to get working.

Elon and the team did it in nineteen days.
Never been done before.

@elonmusk  @JensenHuang

quote.name: Bowie
quote.text:
Two builders on one stage, talking about a future where you just tell the car, “Take me home,” and it does.

An order of magnitude safer than a person. In the distant future, Elon said, people may even outlaw human driving, because you can’t have a person behind a two-ton death machine.

That is not a flex. That is a responsibility. Elon has been trying to make it real. Jensen helped give the world the computing power to even attempt it.

I support them both. 

The future gets safer when people like this keep building it.

@elonmusk  @JensenHuang
